summary: Tested Excel import wizard for Clienti (preview + commit endpoints + UI dialog). 13/13 backend tests pass; frontend E2E pass with full 50-row preview, mapping pills, import, list refresh. Cleaned up 50 imported clienti from DB.

issues: Radix DialogContent emits a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined}'. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to silence and improve a11y.

action_items: Optional: add <DialogDescription> to ImportClientiDialog for a11y compliance.

Optional improvement: duplicate check key uses lowercased denominazione + numeric-only partita_iva — works well but soft-deleted/deactivated clienti are still flagged as duplicates on re-import. Document or add an 'attivo:true' filter on the duplicate lookup if desired.

Optional: filter mapping/header lookup is currently case-sensitive on file-side text; works for the provided file (Italian headers). If user uploads files with all-caps or accented chars, may miss mapping — already handled via _norm() (lowercase + collapsed spaces). Confirmed working for this file.
critical_code_review_comments: imports.py is 371 lines — within acceptable size. Good separation: parsing helpers / _build_cliente / endpoints.
Duplicate check correctly uses partita_iva + denominazione_struttura key, applied both at preview and commit (defense in depth).
Tenant scoping correct: tenant_id_of(user) used in existing lookup and in inserted doc.
5MB / 2000-row / extension validation all enforced before parsing — good.
MongoDB _id excluded via projection in existing lookup; inserted docs avoid _id leak. OK.
Frontend dialog cleanly resets on close and on 'Cambia file' button. onImported callback wired to fetchList — verified list refreshed from 1 → 76 rows after committing 50.
